title: Northgate Credit Cards Product Line-Up and Membership Pairing Schedule
content:
Every Northgate Credit Cards account is issued by Meridian Trust Bank and linked to a Northgate membership. This schedule gives, for each of the six card products, the network it runs on, the bank that issues and services it, where it can be used, the membership segment it must be linked to and the membership tiers it can be linked to.

## Schedule

| Card product | Network | Issuing and servicing bank | Where the card can be used | Membership segment the card must be linked to | Membership tiers the card can be linked to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card | Private label | Meridian Trust Bank | At Northgate only | Consumer | Northgate Student Club Membership, Northgate Heroes Club Membership, Northgate Club Membership, Northgate Club Plus Membership |
| Northgate Business Store Card | Private label | Meridian Trust Bank | At Northgate only | Business | Northgate Business Membership, Northgate Business Plus Membership |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | Visa | Meridian Trust Bank | Everywhere Visa is accepted | Consumer | Northgate Student Club Membership, Northgate Heroes Club Membership, Northgate Club Membership |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | Visa | Meridian Trust Bank | Everywhere Visa is accepted | Business | Northgate Business Membership |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | Visa | Meridian Trust Bank | Everywhere Visa is accepted | Consumer | Northgate Club Plus Membership |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | Visa | Meridian Trust Bank | Everywhere Visa is accepted | Business | Northgate Business Plus Membership |

## The same schedule read by membership tier

Each membership tier below is followed by the card products whose list of membership tiers names it. The list says only which products name the tier; it states nothing further about an individual member.

- Northgate Student Club Membership: Northgate Store Card; Northgate Rewards Visa Signature.
- Northgate Heroes Club Membership: Northgate Store Card; Northgate Rewards Visa Signature.
- Northgate Club Membership: Northgate Store Card; Northgate Rewards Visa Signature.
- Northgate Club Plus Membership: Northgate Store Card; Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus.
- Northgate Business Membership: Northgate Business Store Card; Northgate Rewards Visa Business.
- Northgate Business Plus Membership: Northgate Business Store Card; Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus.

## Notes to the schedule

- **Network and acceptance.** The two store cards run on a private-label network and are accepted at Northgate only. The four Rewards Visa products run on Visa and are accepted everywhere Visa is accepted.
- **Bank.** Meridian Trust Bank is the issuing bank for all six products and services each account.
- **Segment.** Three products are linked to consumer memberships (Northgate Store Card, Northgate Rewards Visa Signature, Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus) and three to business memberships (Northgate Business Store Card, Northgate Rewards Visa Business, Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus).
- **Store cards span the Plus tier of their segment.** The Northgate Store Card names Northgate Club Plus Membership alongside the three other consumer tiers, and the Northgate Business Store Card names both business tiers; each Rewards Visa product names either the Plus tier of its segment or the tiers other than it, never both.
